# Apache ECharts

`echarts-6.1.0.min.js` is Apache ECharts 6.1.0, vendored so the RAC transfer
dashboard and its standalone HTML export work without a network connection.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts@6.1.0/dist/echarts.min.js
